description: This PHP source file defines the RelationshipController class, which handles API requests related to relationships, utilizing a RelationshipService for business logic. It includes methods for getting, creating, linking, and deleting relationships, with exception handling and response generation.

classes.name: RelationshipController
classes.description: Controller class for managing API endpoints related to relationships, extending BaseController, and utilizing RelationshipService for core operations.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a relationship using provided parameters.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new relationship with given parameters.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a relationship based on provided parameters.
